ai_summary: Anik Industries Limited reported a substantial year-on-year revenue decline in Q2 and H1 FY27, with standalone net sales for the half-year plummeting by over 50% compared to the prior year. While H1 standalone net profit remained stable, Q2 standalone profitability sharply decreased despite higher sequential revenue, indicating significant margin pressure. A material red flag is the auditor's explicit note that the financial information of the loss-making subsidiary was not independently reviewed and was solely certified by management, introducing uncertainty regarding its impact on consolidated results.
